gas_model.validated_on: 11 successful Bradbury deploys, max error 0.01%, plus the v0.2 spine deploy at 0.11%
gas_model.caveat: Validates gasUsed, not estimates. Estimates run ~6% above gasUsed. The model under-predicted this v0.3 estimate by 7.86%, outside its validated input range (max 20068 inputBytes; v0.3 is 22988). Use the real estimate, not the model, beyond that range.

verdict: v0.3 origin binding is behaviorally complete and locally green, but the single-file contract cannot be deployed to Bradbury: the estimate 18719528 exceeds the observed accept ceiling 16773925. No address claimed. No transaction broadcast.
next: Open the modular split as a separate authority under its own Work Contract. The registry and/or the proposal adapter must move to a second contract so each deploy fits its own envelope. Do not re-attempt this source shape.

statusCorrection.finding: The assumed ceiling of 16,773,925 was never a measured network maximum; it was the lowest gasLimit the prior session happened to try. The measured acceptance ceiling is ~20,861,997 (conservative).
statusCorrection.conclusion: The v0.3 monolith was NOT blocked by the network. The verdict came from treating a self-imposed submit value as a ceiling and from walking gas downward instead of upward. The modular split remains the correct architecture and proceeds, but the network-blocks-it rationale recorded here was incorrect.
statusCorrection.behaviourThatWasReal: The earlier capped submits at 15.0M-16.77M genuinely reverted because the monolith required ~18.7M; those were BELOW the requirement, not above a ceiling.
